name: SillyTavern Summarize (memory extension)
ontology_notes: One string summary stored on a chat message as extra.memory (setMemoryContext in public/scripts/extensions/memory/index.js). Injected via setExtensionPrompt MODULE_NAME='1_memory' with template default '[Summary: {{summary}}]'. Not a fact list. Docs call long-term-memory claims 'a grain of salt'.

ontology.evidence: Single free-text summary. No types. Default prompt asks for important facts and events in the story so far.
ontology.label: measured

write_policy.evidence: Main API (raw blocking/non-blocking or classic blocking), WebLLM, or Extras BART. Interval: promptInterval messages and/or promptForceWords. User can Pause (memoryFrozen), edit the box, or Restore Previous. Interval 0 disables auto but Summarize now still works.
write_policy.label: measured

read_policy.evidence: Always inject the current summary string when non-empty (formatMemoryValue + setExtensionPrompt). Position/depth/role match Author's Note options. Empty summary injects nothing.
read_policy.label: measured

supersession.evidence: New summary replaces the displayed current summary. Prior summary remains on an older message extra until Restore Previous deletes the latest extra.memory. Not fact-level supersession.
supersession.label: measured

temporal.evidence: The blob has no timestamps or session ids. Older detail is dropped by the summarizer, not windowed.
temporal.label: measured

identity_split.evidence: One summary for the chat. Classic builder can include the character card; Raw builder omits WI/AN. Still one string.
identity_split.label: measured

silence.evidence: Pause, clear the box, or SkipWIAN so WI/AN are not summarized (classic only). No policy for not storing a joke as fact beyond the user editing the summary.
silence.label: measured

poisoning.evidence: Docs warn of hallucinations. The summary is trusted prompt. No provenance. Raw mode can feed a lot of chat into a second LLM call.
poisoning.label: measured

forgetting.evidence: Restore Previous, manual edit, Pause. Deleting or editing the message that holds extra.memory reverts to the last valid summary (docs).
forgetting.label: measured

cost_shape.evidence: Extra LLM (or BART) call on interval. Token formula in docs: max summary buffer = context size - summarization prompt - previous summary - response length. Injection occupies prompt tokens every turn after the first summary exists. Extras BART ~1024 token context.
cost_shape.label: measured

local.evidence: Can use the user's local Main API or WebLLM. Extras summarize module is optional/local but Extras is discontinued. AGPL-3.0.
local.label: measured

companion_fit_reason: A user-editable rolling summary is pinned working memory, which companions need when history falls out of context. It compresses and can invent. It is not typed relationship state.
open_unknowns: WebLLM summary quality vs Main API (not measured here).
